northern-kentucky-convention-center.mobi: There are accessible restrooms for each gender readily available in public areas.
Meeting Rooms/Ballroom/The Learning Center/Event Center – All are accessible by wheelchair.
The Learning Center 400 seat amphitheater (with accessible seating)

The Center has 2 wheelchairs available for use on a first come, first serve basis. These chairs are located within the Administrative Offices and must be signed out. Photo identification will also be required to be left on file until the return of the chair.
There are ramps available for riser accessibility and should be requested ahead of time to prepare for use.

The Center only allows powered wheelchairs, scooters, and Segway’s for people with disabilities as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act and if they can be operated safely in our facility. Only electric or battery powered OPDMD are allowed inside the facility. OPDMD cannot travel at a speed greater than the pedestrian traffic.
northern-kentucky-convention-center.chro: Do you have a nursing room?
Yes, we have 2 mamava pods. One on each level.
dinsmore-homestead.mobility.1: For visitors who rely on wheelchairs and walkers, designated, accessible parking is available next to the office and gift shop.
dinsmore-homestead.mobility.2: Much of the grounds are wheelchair accessible. The path to the house is compacted gravel.
dinsmore-homestead.mobility.3: The wheelchair ramp, at the back of the house, gives access to the interior of the house (only the first floor).
The upstairs of the Dinsmore home is not wheelchair accessible.
dinsmore-homestead.mobility.4: The Dinsmore family graveyard is located on the top of a hill roughly .2 miles behind the house and requires an able body with a walking stick to manage. The path up to the graveyard is a hiking trail and can become slick in wet conditions.
dinsmore-homestead.cognitive.1: So that we can make your visit as enjoyable as possible, please contact us in advance of your visit and we will make all efforts to accommodate your limitations and share as much of the Dinsmore family experience as possible through mobile exhibits and additional artifacts.
tql-stadium.mobility.1: TQL Stadium offers wheelchair accessible and low mobility seating on each level of the stadium at comparable prices and sightlines. Tickets for all ADA sections are available to purchase directly through the FC Cincinnati Ticketing Department. They can be reached prior to each event at 513-977-5425. Event-day sales of ADA tickets are available, but are typically limited.
tql-stadium.mobility.2: Guests needing wheelchair accommodations are encouraged to bring their own mobility devices to TQL Stadium. If assistance is needed, guests should notify the closest Guest Experience representative located at any entrance or visit the Guest Experience Center located behind Section E6/220 upon their arrival and request the use of a wheelchair. Wheelchairs belonging to TQL Stadium are operated by Guest Experience staff and are available for transit between gates and seating locations. Wheelchair transport service to and from entrances to a guest’s seat is available on a first-come, first-served basis and demand may cause an increase in wait time for an accommodation. We are unable to allow guests to keep wheelchairs throughout the events.
tql-stadium.sensory.1: Sensory bags are available for guests to use during each event. Each bag contains a pair of noise canceling headphones, as well as other items that stimulate the senses. These bags are located in the Guest Experience Center behind section E6. Guests may check out these bags by providing a credit card or Photo ID. Any questions regarding sensory bags should be directed to the Guest Experience Center. P&G Sensory Room Any guest who is in need of a therapeutic, quiet space to go to during events is welcome to use the Sensory room, located in the back of the Guest Experience Center behind section E6. This room features a variety of equipment that guests can use in ways to regulate their brain’s negative reactions to external stimuli
tql-stadium.chronic.1: If you have a medical condition that prevents you from passing through a magnetometer, an alternative method of screening will be used.
tql-stadium.mobility.3: For the convenience of any guest with a disability, all gates at TQL Stadium are equipped with easily accessible lines to minimize wait times.
tql-stadium.cognitive.2: First Financial Gate is on the east side of TQL Stadium off Central Parkway.
tql-stadium.mobility.4: Elevators: Priority use of passenger elevators will be given to guests and staff with limited mobility. Stairs should be used to navigate the stadium whenever possible. Some elevators are used to move the media and team staff and will be periodically taken out of service for this purpose. To ensure safe and efficient operations of the elevators, we ask our guests to follow the directions of the elevator operators, the elevator lobby attendants, and other stadium staff at all times. For assistance with finding an elevator, please locate the closest Guest Experience team member.
tql-stadium.mobility.5: Note: These garages are for parking passes ONLY. There is no cash parking at these garages on matchdays.
Town Center Garage (ADA) : 1223 Central Parkway, Cincinnati, Ohio 45214
tql-stadium.cognitive.3: Fans who have scheduled a rideshare service (Taxi, Uber, Lyft) will be dropped off/picked up at one of three locations near TQL Stadium: Ezzard Charles Drive Central Avenue West 14th Street South Side of Liberty, Eastbound between John Street and Central Avenue.
Wade Street is closed to pedestrians and vehicles due to construction.
tql-stadium.mobility.6: Supporters Section: Tickets for the Supporters Section (sections 106-110) at TQL Stadium are general admission and are sold on a first-come, first-served basis. Tickets in this location will be ‘safe standing’ and will not have a physical seat.
The Bailey supporter section is an exception to this rule.
tql-stadium.cognitive.4: Supporter sections do not allow yellow or opposing team colors.
tql-stadium.sensory.3: FC Cincinnati host Nashville SC on Saturday, November 7 at TQL Stadium.
The Bailey is general admission, safe standing only. Singing, drums, flags, and smoke are expected during the match.
